scope: Frag5 header and sparse geometry preflight only; no CT or PNG pixel decoding
unexpected_200_policy: Close without reading body and stop this execution; do not fall back to full download
tiff_scope: Header, IFD entries and referenced metadata only; no strip/tile pixel payload
png_scope: First 33 bytes only: signature, IHDR and IHDR CRC; no PLTE/IDAT/pixel decoding
ppm_header_scope: 64-byte ranges up to first <> line, at most 4096 header bytes; any incidental binary suffix remains undecoded

ppm_geometry_selection.formula: floor(k * (dimension - 1) / 10), k=1..9; Cartesian product in row-major YX order
ppm_geometry_selection.record_scope: Only prescribed geometry records; no data-dependent additional locations
ppm_geometry_selection.endianness: Report header declaration if available and empirical little/big-endian compatibility separately; do not infer format guarantee from plausibility alone
